test_cases.description: TC-1. Verify the connected reviewer identity and organization binding.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, show which identity I am connected as and my membership state.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_get_identity once with organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. Returns ok true, organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, the reviewer account email, membership role "developer", status "active" and bindingState "bound", and OAuth scopes that include "openid" and "user:org:read". No token, key or credential value is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-2. List the seeded logical agent and its single Codex endpoint.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list my logical agents and their endpoint bindings.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_list_agents once. Returns exactly one agent, with agent_key {{REVIEWER_AGENT_KEY}}, bound to exactly one endpoint: id {{REVIEWER_CODEX_ENDPOINT_ID}}, endpoint_kind "local_provider", provider "codex", credential_boundary "local_device", status "active", workspace_id {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}}. No local path or credential is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-3. List the five seeded redacted trajectory capsules.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list the 5 most recent redacted trajectory capsules.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_list_trajectories once with limit 5. Returns exactly 5 trajectories, newest first: 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001. Each has provider "codex", evidence_mode "structured", status "observed", latest_revision 1 and workspace_id {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}}. No evidence is expanded.

test_cases.description: TC-4. Open one seeded trajectory capsule only after explicit confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: After I confirm, open the bounded evidence for trajectory 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 in Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks for confirmation before the call, then calls fabric_get_trajectory_evidence with confirmed true. Returns trajectory id 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 with provider "codex" and exactly one revision (revision 1) whose capsule_hash is {{REVIEWER_T1_CAPSULE_HASH}}, a redacted capsule summary and an empty validation_results list. No raw transcript, local path or credential is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-5. Dispatch a read-only smoke task to the seeded Codex endpoint after explicit confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: After I confirm, in Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}} dispatch a remediation_smoke task to endpoint {{REVIEWER_CODEX_ENDPOINT_ID}} in workspace {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}} with the instructions "Report the first heading of README.md. Do not change any file." Allow read path README.md only, no write paths, no commands, and network deny.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks for confirmation before the call, then calls fabric_dispatch_task with confirmed true, taskType "remediation_smoke", readPaths ["README.md"], empty writePaths and commandIds, and network "deny". Returns ok true and a new task with status "offered", task_type "remediation_smoke", target_endpoint_id {{REVIEWER_CODEX_ENDPOINT_ID}}, workspace_id {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}}, a sha256 envelope_hash and a correlationId. Each run creates a new task id. The task cannot merge or deploy.

test_cases.description: TC-6. Create an organization control-agent conversation after explicit confirmation, without running a model.
test_cases.user_prompt: After I confirm, create a Dharma control-agent conversation titled "Reviewer check" in organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. Do not send it a message.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks for confirmation before the call, then calls fabric_control_agent_create_session with confirmed true and title "Reviewer check". Returns ok true, a new session titled "Reviewer check" and a correlationId. No message is sent, no model runs and no credits are used. Each run creates a new session id.

test_cases.description: TC-7. Show that an admin-only rollback is refused for a developer member, after explicit confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: After I confirm, roll back the signed skill rollout for bundle {{REVIEWER_CANARY_BUNDLE_ID}} in Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks for confirmation before the call, then calls fabric_rollout_rollback with confirmed true and bundleId {{REVIEWER_CANARY_BUNDLE_ID}}. The tool returns an error with code "insufficient_scope" because the reviewer is a developer member and rollback requires an organization admin. The rollout is unchanged, so the same result repeats on every run.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Agent Fabric for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. Calendar access is outside the app’s supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuse arbitrary shell access outside bounded task policy.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Dharma to run any shell command on every engineer’s laptop and upload their home directories.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. The app has no arbitrary shell or file-upload tool, and fabric_dispatch_task only sends one confirmed, bounded task to one registered endpoint under its workspace command policy.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not retrieve provider or organization secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the GitHub App private key and every local provider credential in the organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. Secret retrieval is not supported, and no tool returns credentials or keys.
